facts.fact: 万圣节夜 powwow 上，警长来抓一个「Nona Beaujee / Nanabozho」——他其实在找 Trickster（恶作剧精灵）。
facts.anchor: “Someone named Nona Beaujee or Boujoo. That name ring a bell?”

facts.fact: Suzie 曾经最爱的纹身是奥吉布瓦神话里的 Wintermaker（造冬者），后来她花了两周痛苦的疗程把它改成蝴蝶。
facts.anchor: The image and story of Wintermaker had been her favorite.

facts.fact: Stone 年轻时因毒驾超速撞上松树，害死了青梅竹马的 TT；他从乐天派变成终身哀悼者。
facts.anchor: Stone had been driving—driving high, and driving fast.

facts.fact: 朋友们把警长引到 Sweet Landing 的古坟地，假装 Nanabozho 藏在那里。
facts.anchor: It’s the public landing by the old burial mounds. Good two-track out that way. No prob.

facts.fact: Stone 掏出蓝色鱼形醒酒器，谎称是驱邪药，让警长和副警长喝下会拉肚子的「药」。
facts.anchor: He pulled a retro blue fish decanter from inside his jacket. Instantly, the two lawmen were at his side.

facts.fact: 借着「献祭」的名义，Stone 哄得两名警员把钱包、钥匙、武器都掏出来塞进袜子里。
facts.anchor: “Oh, no, Sirs. You must leave the weapons, too. The weapons must stay. And some coins,” he added.

facts.fact: 神秘男子自称 Waabooz——「恶作剧精灵兼药理天才」。
facts.anchor: “Allow me to introduce myself properly. Waabooz, trickster and pharmacological genius, at your service.”

facts.fact: 第二天 Suzie 打开红头巾，里面是一尊精美的烟斗石雕像——正是她旧纹身 Wintermaker 的完美复制品。
facts.anchor: Instead, she held an exquisite pipestone carving.

facts.fact: 结尾 Suzie 用左手接过烟草，向众灵发誓「All in」（全力投入）。
facts.anchor: To any spirits listening, she made her vow. All in.
